popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Books 1–2: after the sun-chariot crash, Phaethon falls into the Eridanus; nymphs bury him on the bank and his sisters, the Heliades, become poplars weeping amber into the mythical river.

popCulture.title: Eridanus (constellation)
popCulture.description: The long celestial river south of Taurus still bears the mythic name — Eridanus as sky-stream after the Phaethon catastrophe.

popCulture.title: Eridanos (mythology)
popCulture.description: Mythical river of amber and mourning — identified with the Po, the Rhine, or a stream of Hades — forever linked to Phaethon's fall.
